subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Third-Party Logistics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Third-Party Logistics.

hook.text: A startup sells globally but owns no trucks, no warehouses, no forklifts. A 3PL handles it all.

buildup.text: Third-party logistics providers (3PLs) manage warehousing, transport, and fulfillment for other companies.

discovery.text: They leverage scale—aggregating volume from many clients—to negotiate lower rates than any one client could.

twist.text: You lose direct control. If the 3PL makes a mistake, your customer blames you, not them.

climax.text: The global 3PL market exceeds $1 trillion. Most e-commerce companies rely on them to scale.

punchline.text: Outsource the logistics. Keep the customer relationship.

quiz.question: What is the main advantage of a 3PL?
options: Lower rates through scale and no capital investment
